question: Conditional count/PPE bootstrap variability of existing domain-eligible withheld-place pollen predictions, with shared source dependencies and explicit undefined mass.
source_pins_scope: Whole-source/index pins authenticate accounting; each fold scientific ancestry binds only its allowed owner-specific draw members, shared target-free PPE and target geometry.

sampling.count_law: fixed-total multinomial with each retained owner/window count vector normalized by its original integer total
sampling.ppe_law: existing rnorm_reveals whole-vector nonnegative NORMAL rejection; a sampled zero retains subsequent strict-positive model refusal
sampling.sharing: One PPE vector per replicate across all regional/local/forward calls and folds; one count vector per physical source owner/window reused across every allowed training fold.

population.rule: Propagate only previously frozen nominal predicted cases; preserve all original refused cases without attempting stochastic rescue.

fixed_conditions: Previously selected source point chronologies and half-open bins
Original static regional/local basin geometry and all-terrestrial annuli
Saved original finite kernels, ring selection and distances; not the separate true-continuous-law study
Published parameter transfer as a conditional working model; normal components independent before their shared reuse

summaries.conditional_mean_mcse: sqrt(unbiased conditional sample variance / defined replicate count); unavailable with fewer than two defined replicates
summaries.undefined_mass: undefined replicate count / 1024; unconditional composition summary refused if any replicate is undefined
summaries.direct_counterpart: Same two training owner count-draw compositions and fixed mean/nearest/inverse-squared-distance weights; independent of KRAG/PPE
summaries.matched_contrasts: Physical/direct contrasts use explicitly common-defined rows; any equal-three-target aggregate uses the intersection of complete replicate IDs.

outcome_policy: Existing exposed target fractions may be reopened for score diagnostics only after all prediction products are durably frozen and read back. No target count/total, outcome or all-owner quantitative hash enters its own fold prediction or scientific ancestry.
unsupported_claims: Regional representativeness or dated basin truth
Numerical integration precision beyond fixed saved kernels
